name: run OCR and classify each document as invoice or other from content
definition: Extract text from scanned JPG and PDF files and label each as matching an invoice index or not.
failure_mode: A misclassified file ends up in the wrong folder and hash-set comparison fails.

name: write a move as a zero-indexed coordinate pair
definition: emit the chosen cell as two comma-separated integers in row,column order within the board range (0 to 14).
failure_mode: wrong order, out-of-range, or an occupied value fails.
